jobs.description:

Our mission-built products— Ambient AI and Guardian— are transforming strategic, operational, and tactical decision-making. By empowering the shift from reactive analysis to proactive, predictive intelligence and decision support, Rhombus Power is providing foresight and freedom of action when it matters most.

Location

Washington, D.C.

Job Description

As an Intelligence Analyst at Rhombus Power, you will create impactful intelligence assessments on topics including foreign military activities, information operations, regional conflicts, and country stability to support U.S. and Allied national security decision making. Analysts will fuse Rhombus Power’s unique, AI-derived data with a spectrum of open-source information to create these products.

Our Intelligence Analysts routinely perform thorough research and analysis on global security topics guided by client intelligence needs. The outputs from these efforts are primarily conveyed through intelligence assessments written in accordance with U.S. Intelligence Community standards; however, Analysts also deliver tailored briefings for internal and external audiences on topics in their areas of responsibility.

Candidates must excel at collaborative work and must exhibit strong interpersonal skills, as all team efforts depend on working closely within the intelligence team and with other cross-functional teams. Candidates should be able to provide and receive feedback that enhances overall team outputs and the company’s proprietary AI features.

Successful candidates will be solution-oriented self-starters who are tech savvy, can identify problems and opportunities, and propose solutions in a dynamic and fast-paced environment. Flexibility and the ability to multitask and prioritize efforts are crucial due to the pace of global events and the sometimes rapidly evolving needs of our clients.

We are seeking a candidate with subject matter expertise on the Russian military, preferably with experience in a U.S. military or government intelligence role. The ideal candidate will have significant knowledge of Russian military capabilities, hybrid warfare, and information operations with an up-to-date understanding of Russia’s invasion of Ukraine and the threat it poses to NATO countries. Candidates must have strong writing skills and be capable of producing a high volume of quality analytic assessments under tight deadlines and with minimal review.

If you do not have experience as an analyst in the U.S. Intelligence Community, a writing sample will be requested as part of your application for this role and is a requirement for consideration. All writing samples must be your own work and ideally will have been produced within the last 3 years. The sample should be between one and three pages in length and assess a geopolitical or international security-related topic.

Responsibilities

Identify impactful intelligence topics based on a detailed understanding of client intelligence needs and missions.
Produce high-quality intelligence assessments that answer our clients most important intelligence questions by following U.S. Intelligence Community intelligence analysis and writing standards.
Utilize Rhombus Power’s AI-informed intelligence capabilities and expert research skills to gather information that serves as the foundation of intelligence products.
Identify information gaps and work with the Model and Data Development team to acquire sources of information to bridge gaps.
Utilize structured analytic techniques to ensure team intelligence products meet the highest standards.
Brief finished intelligence products.
Support enhancement of Rhombus Power intelligence capabilities by providing feedback on existing features and supporting the development of new applications and features.
Serve as a subject matter expert on Russia with a focus on operations in Ukraine and threats to NATO.

Qualifications

Minimum of 5 (five) years’ analytic experience with subject matter expertise related to Russia and its military.
Analytic experience and training with the U.S. Intelligence Community or military are strongly desired.
At minimum, a BA or BS in International Affairs, Political Science, Economics, or a similar social science field. An advanced degree is desired.
Experience writing intelligence products tailored to answering key client intelligence questions.
Experience providing briefings on complex national security and international affairs topics.
Familiarity using and developing qualitative and quantitative analytical methodologies.
Intellectual curiosity and emotional intelligence.
We are seeking candidates who would be eligible for a DoD Secret or Top Secret security clearance. If you currently hold a clearance, please indicate the level and sponsoring agency.
Familiarity with data analysis, statistics, data science, big data manipulation, and coding (Python, etc.) is particularly welcome.

Salary
Range

This position has an estimated base salary range of $75,000/year to $220,000/year. Final salary will be determined based on location, experience, and qualifications.

Benefits

Full medical, dental, vision coverage for employee and dependents
401k matching program
PTO and Holidays
Bonus and other incentive programs
Access to mental health program
Access to Flexible Spending Accounts for Health Care, Dependent and Commuter

(Rhombus) is a startup located in the heart of Silicon Valley at Stanford Research Park in Palo Alto.  We use cutting-edge cross-disciplinary approaches to solve pressing Big Data and Sensing problems in security, energy, and healthcare. Our advisory board includes two Nobel Laureates and a Draper Prize winner.

About Pacific Fusion

Pacific Fusion was founded in 2023 with the mission to power the world with abundant, affordable, clean energy.

We are rapidly designing and building a pulser-driven inertial fusion system to achieve net facility gain (more fusion energy output than stored energy input). In parallel, we are developing the key components required to build affordable fusion systems.

Our plans are ambitious. We have raised over $900M so far from incredible investors, resourcing us to deliver on these plans. We are bringing together the best scientists, engineers, and operators from the fusion community, hard tech industry, and other sectors. We are united by a shared sense of urgency to provide clean power for the world, particularly managing climate change while meeting growing global energy demand. You can read more about us in this letter from our founders.

Engineers, designers, scientists, and technicians rely on our CAD ecosystem and PLM integration to rapidly iterate on complex mechanical and electrical assemblies. Deep administrative expertise with major CAD platforms (e.g., PTC Creo Parametric, SolidWorks, Altium) and their system configuration tools

Experience with CAD automation, scripting (e.g., Creo Toolkit, Python, VB.net), or macro development to streamline repetitive design tasks

Curve Biosciences™ | Full Time | On-site - San Mateo, CA

or Associate Scientist

RiboForge is a stealth biotechnology startup focused on advancing RNA-targeted drug discovery at the cutting edge of the field. The team is dedicated to developing innovative therapeutic approaches that leverage RNA biology to address unmet medical needs. As an early-stage company, RiboForge offers opportunities to contribute directly to foundational research and platform development. Team members can expect a highly collaborative, science-driven environment that values curiosity, rigor, and creativity.

About the Role

We are seeking a motivated laboratory assistant to work on-site, part-time or full-time, with our
medicinal chemistry team. This is a great opportunity for someone with a passion for
science who is interested in pursuing a career in biotechnology or the pharmaceutical
industry. For the right candidate, there is potential to transition into a full-time position as
the company grows. The role centers on the synthesis, purification, and characterization of novel small molecules to aid hit-to-lead optimization discovery efforts. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys organic synthesis, detailed characterization work, and is eager to translate those skills into future therapeutics. 

Key Responsibilities

Multi-Step Organic Synthesis:
Execute the synthesis of novel target molecules, intermediates, and focused chemical libraries across parallel and multi-step reaction sequences (milligram to gram scale).
Purification & Isolation:
Utilize modern purification techniques, including liquid-liquid extraction, crystallization, flash chromatography (normal/reverse-phase), and preparative HPLC.
Compound Characterization:
Characterize intermediates and final compounds using analytical instrumentation, including 1D/2D NMR (1H, 13C, 19F), LC-MS, HPLC, and HRMS, ensuring high purity (>95%) for biological evaluation.
Data Interpretation & Troubleshooting:
Analyze analytical data, troubleshoot challenging synthetic routes, optimize reaction conditions, and propose alternative synthetic strategies.
Documentation & Compliance:
Maintain precise, timely laboratory notebook records, adhere to chemical hygiene plans and standard operating procedures, and handle hazardous materials safely in compliance with OSHA/EHS guidelines.

Requirements

Education:
B.S. in Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, or a closely related discipline.
2–4 years of laboratory experience in synthetic organic or medicinal chemistry (academic or industrial setting).
Technical Skills:

Demonstrated command of standard organic chemistry reaction mechanisms, reagent handling (including air-/moisture-sensitive reagents, inert atmospheres, and cryogenic conditions).
Hands-on proficiency in operating and interpreting data from LC-MS, NMR spectrometers, and automated chromatography systems (e.g., Biotage, Teledyne ISCO).
Working knowledge of chemical drawing and informatics software (e.g., ChemDraw, SciFinder, Reaxys).

Preferred Qualifications

Extensive synthetic experience; Prior experience in a pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry drug discovery environment. 
Foundational understanding of drug discovery principles, physicochemical properties (LogP/LogD, solubility, PSA), and basic in vitro ADME assays.
Familiarity with PyMOL

medicinal chemistry team. This is a great opportunity for someone with a passion for
science who is interested in pursuing a career in biotechnology or the pharmaceutical
industry. For the right candidate, there is potential to transition into a full-time position as
the company grows. The role centers on the synthesis, purification, and characterization of novel small molecules to aid hit-to-lead optimization discovery efforts. This role is well suited to someone who enjoys organic synthesis, detailed characterization work, and is eager to translate those skills into future therapeutics.

Multi-Step Organic Synthesis:
Execute the synthesis of novel target molecules, intermediates, and focused chemical libraries across parallel and multi-step reaction sequences (milligram to gram scale).
Purification & Isolation:

Compound Characterization:
Characterize intermediates and final compounds using analytical instrumentation, including 1D/2D NMR (1H, 13C, 19F), LC-MS, HPLC, and HRMS, ensuring high purity (>95%) for biological evaluation.
Data Interpretation & Troubleshooting:
Analyze analytical data, troubleshoot challenging synthetic routes, optimize reaction conditions, and propose alternative synthetic strategies.
Documentation & Compliance:
Maintain precise, timely laboratory notebook records, adhere to chemical hygiene plans and standard operating procedures, and handle hazardous materials safely in compliance with OSHA/EHS guidelines.

Education:
B.S. in Chemistry, Organic Chemistry, Medicinal Chemistry, or a closely related discipline.
2–4 years of laboratory experience in synthetic organic or medicinal chemistry (academic or industrial setting).
Technical Skills:

Demonstrated command of standard organic chemistry reaction mechanisms, reagent handling (including air-/moisture-sensitive reagents, inert atmospheres, and cryogenic conditions).
Hands-on proficiency in operating and interpreting data from LC-MS, NMR spectrometers, and automated chromatography systems (e.g., Biotage, Teledyne ISCO).
Working knowledge of chemical drawing and informatics software (e.g., ChemDraw, SciFinder, Reaxys).

Preferred Qualifications

Extensive synthetic experience; Prior experience in a pharmaceutical or biotechnology industry drug discovery environment. 
Foundational understanding of drug discovery principles, physicochemical properties (LogP/LogD, solubility, PSA), and basic in vitro ADME assays.
Familiarity with PyMOL

Submit your resume, cover letter, and references to careers@riboforge.com with the subject line “Research Assistant – Medicinal Chemistry”

Diamond Foundry Inc. is solving the thermal limitation at the foundation of today's most exciting tech industries -- AI & cloud compute, electric-car power electronics, and 5G/6G wireless. We have managed to produce the world's first single-crystal diamond wafers and are now on a mission to put a diamond behind every chip. We are the rare unicorn that has grown fast and profitably. We received $515m in funding and are executing a multi-$B expansion plan for one of the greenest forms of tech manufacturing: converting greenhouse gas into diamond wafers using zero-emission energy.

We are looking for an experienced, communicative Senior Software Engineer to own the data pipelines, internal systems, and APIs that power our real-time manufacturing and R&D operations. What we need from you is deep, production-grade Python expertise and the ability to own a project end-to-end: partnering directly with material engineers, technicians, and hardware engineers to turn ambiguous operational challenges into working production software.

This role will be on-site 5 days a week in either our South San Francisco office or our Fremont, CA office.

Responsibilities

Own technical initiatives from inception to delivery: translate operational needs into technical roadmaps, architectural specs, and deployable code.
Architect and scale end-to-end Python backends, spanning high-throughput event pipelines, internal REST APIs, and automated data processing tools.
Interface directly with internal clients (production technicians, metrology specialists, and R&D engineers) to diagnose workflow bottlenecks and validate solutions on the floor.
Optimize database performance and schema design for high-frequency telemetry, process metrics, and traceability data.
Partner with our front-end engineers to define clean API contracts and data models for operator-facing UI’s.

Requirements

4+ years of software engineering experience with production Python as your primary language (experience with industrial protocols like MQTT, Modbus, OPC-UA, or PLCs is a strong plus).
Proven end-to-end project ownership with the ability to define roadmaps, write specs, and execute code independently (experience working in manufacturing, hardware-in-the-loop, or physical R&D environments is a plus).
Full-lifecycle Python backend expertise across REST APIs, event/data pipelines, and automation scripts (hands-on experience with FastAPI, Flask, or async processing is a plus).
Exceptional interpersonal and communication skills to run discovery directly with non-software stakeholders like scientists, technicians, and operations teams (experience scoping technical requirements directly from physical shop-floor workflows is a plus).
Strong querying skills with schema design fundamentals.

$150,000 - $175,000 a year
